body.text: As you requested from the helpdesk (ticket #3120), please create a new password using this link:
We will never ask for your password or OTP. If you did not request a reset, contact the helpdesk at ext. 110.

explanation: Both the sender and the link use the real office domain (nusadigital.test), and the email greets Sari and refers to a ticket she actually opened. It does not ask for an OTP or any data, so allow it.
hints: Password reset emails are often faked. Check the sender and where the link goes.
Real domain, greets by name, and no OTP request. Anything still off?
